title: AzulC's Mob Statues
description: Deco mod that aims to add unique mob statues/plaques/displays
body:
# ![AzulC's Mob Statues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AzulConspirator/MoreStatues/refs/heads/main/img/proj_title.png)

made for Neoforge-1.21.1

mod that aims to add Displays/Statues/Trophies blocks in to showcase achievements/hunts. all of them are craftable in survival.

Requires [**Geckolib4**](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/)

Some has variant for textures and poses or both [hit with stick/bone to change]


## Mob Checklist

Here is a comprehensive checklist of all official Minecraft mobs to the current version of this mod.

- **Focused** are top priority to get more features
- **low** are priority lowered due to overlap/lack of ideas

### extra note
this mod started with the intentions of supplementing [Handcrafted](https://github.com/terrarium-earth/Handcrafted)'s missing Trophies, which is why most marked as **low** is mainly they already have it. 

il focus on patching up the missing ones from their mods first then il start making my own version of it. 

This mod as no affiliation to Handcrafted or its author(s), i just wanted to add stuff that looks similar their trophies cause it looked cool.
